rules.property_taxes: modeled_owner_property on the account's CPS key (profiles_sept29.py; published-share gate); tenant_occupied_property on ACS contract rent and personal_property_tax on ACS household vehicles (per-person rates by age x the frame's headcount; kappa = the measured share over the standardized one); factor R
